It contains headings, narrative text, tables, numerical values, units, dates, repeated entities, historical comparisons, exploration activities and deliberate validation cases. Recommended prototype functions to test: 1. OCR and text extraction 2. Table extraction 3. Geological field extraction 4. Numerical and unit normalization 5. Cross-table validation 6. Document search and semantic retrieval 7. Topic identification and word cloud generation 8. AI question answering with source/page citations 9. Automated annual-report generation 10. Detection of intentionally inserted inconsistencies. 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY During the 2024–25 reporting period, the Exploration Division conducted geological exploration activities across selected coal-bearing blocks in the Central Sector. The programme covered reconnaissance, regional exploration, detailed exploration, drilling, geological mapping, core logging, sampling and laboratory analysis. The illustrative programme recorded 18,460 metres of drilling against a planned 17,800 metres. The exploration programme focused on improving geological confidence, evaluating coal seam continuity, estimating resources and supporting future mine planning. The test dataset includes information from four illustrative exploration blocks: Karanpur East, Shakti North, Nandini Extension and Surya South. The prototype should be able to identify the difference between planned and achieved drilling, extract resource estimates, identify the highest drilling achievement, compare coal quality parameters, and retrieve evidence for each answer. 2. MAJOR FINDINGS The illustrative exploration programme indicates increased drilling activity compared with the previous two reporting periods. The largest individual drilling contribution in the current test dataset is associated with Surya South. Resource estimates show variation in the relative proportions of measured, indicated and inferred categories. Coal quality parameters also vary among blocks. The prototype should not merely summarize this section. It should independently calculate findings from the underlying tables and identify whether the narrative agrees with the structured data. 12. CHALLENGES OBSERVED DURING EXPLORATION Illustrative operational challenges included delays in access to selected drill locations, weather-related interruptions, variation in core recovery, differences in historical document formats and delays in receiving laboratory results. These statements are synthetic test content and are intended to test topic extraction and classification. 13. RECOMMENDATIONS Future exploration programmes may prioritize areas with insufficient geological confidence, improve digital capture of borehole information, standardize data dictionaries, increase structured storage of laboratory results and establish consistent document templates across reporting cycles. For the AI prototype, standardized metadata and controlled vocabularies should be maintained alongside the original documents. 14. INTENTIONAL TEST CASES FOR AI VALIDATION The following records are deliberately included to test whether the prototype can detect contradictions rather than blindly repeat information. Test ID Issue Expected System Behaviour VAL-001 Shakti North planned drilling = 5,100 m but achieved = 4,920 m. Calculate achievement below 100% and flag as below plan. VAL-002 Nandini Extension resource values sum to 120.90 Mt. Confirm Total = Measured + Indicated + Inferred. VAL-003 Annual drilling total = 18,460 m; block totals should sum to the same value. Cross-check total and flag if mismatch. VAL-004 Quality table has different GCV values by block. Answer comparison questions from the source table, not from assumptions. VAL-005 Historical resource values differ by year. Retrieve the correct reporting period before answering. 17. SAMPLE QUESTIONS TO ASK YOUR AI SYSTEM Q1. What was the total drilling achieved during 2024–25? Q2. Which block achieved the highest drilling metres? Q3. Which block had drilling below its planned target? Q4. What was the total illustrative resource estimated in 2024–25? Q5. Break down the total resource into measured, indicated and inferred categories. Q6. Which block had the highest illustrative GCV? Q7. What was the average core recovery across all blocks? Q8. How did drilling change between 2023–24 and 2024–25? Q9. Which exploration activity had the highest utilisation percentage? Q10. Generate an executive summary based only on the information contained in this document. Q11. Show the page/table evidence supporting the answer. Q12. Identify any inconsistencies in the report. 18.
